overview: Chrissy Houlahan seeks another term in a Philadelphia-area district that leans Democratic by about six points. She enters with roughly $4 million on hand after raising $1.8 million, while Republican Marty Young has raised about $411,000 with $213,000 in the bank and no outside spending on either side. Prediction markets give Houlahan about a 97% chance of winning. No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available for this race, so the outlook rests on district lean, incumbency, and the financial gap, all of which favor the incumbent by a wide margin.
